name: aoe2mc.tutorial.barracks
text: Build a barracks: right click on a selected villager, choose da barracks and place it. Da action bar above da hotbar tells u where to place it lol.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camera
text: Move fast over da map: right click with da "Camera" item, walk, then right click with it again lol.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camp
text: Destroy da enemy camp in da middle of da map: select ur Militia and right click on a building lol. Da boss bar at da top shows da step.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camps
text: Build a lumber camp near da trees and a mill near da berriez lol. Da sidebar on da right shows da wood dey cost.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.complete
text: Da tutorial iz complete lol. Next: play a game against da bot: python3 game/run.py OUTWorld --play --bot

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.feudal
text: Goez to da Feudal Age: right click on ur town center and choose da Feudal Age lol. Da sidebar on da right shows ur food.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.food
text: Gather 100 food: send a villager to da berriez lol. Da sidebar on da right shows ur food.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.house
text: Build a house: right click on a selected villager, choose da house and place it lol. Da action bar above da hotbar tells u where to place it.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.militia
text: Train 3 Militia: right click on ur barracks and choose da militia lol. Da sidebar on da right shows ur food and gold.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.raid
text: Da enemy attackz ur villagerz lol! Click da red alert line in da chat to go dere lol, then select ur Militia and right click on da enemiez. Da boss bar at da top shows da health of da selected unit.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.select
text: Select a villager: left click on one of ur villagerz with da command stick lol. Da boss bar at da top shows da selected unit, da action bar above da hotbar shows da next action.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_barracks
text: TIP lol: da barracks trainz infantry. Infantry iz cheap and good against buildingz.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camp
text: TIP lol: attack with all ur unitz together. A small group dies before it can do damage.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camps
text: TIP lol: build da drop-off buildingz near da resourcez, so dat da villagerz walk a short way.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_feudal
text: TIP lol: da next age unlocks new buildingz, unitz and technologiez. Keep da villagerz at work while u goez on.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_food
text: TIP lol: berriez near a mill are a safe start of food. Later, farmz give food dat does not end.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_house
text: TIP lol: a house gives room for 5 more population. Look at da population in da sidebar and build housez before it iz full.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_militia
text: TIP lol: u can queue up to 15 unitz in a building when u has resourcez.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_raid
text: TIP lol: in AoE2 da town bell sends da villagerz into da town center. Ring it when da enemy raidz ur town.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_select
text: TIP lol: da Idle line of da sidebar on da right counts ur villagerz with no work. Give dem work.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_villager
text: TIP lol: train villagerz all da time in da first agez. More villagerz give more resourcez.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_wood
text: TIP lol: villagerz gather faster near a drop-off building. Build a lumber camp next to da trees.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.villager
text: Train a villager: right click on ur town center and choose da villager lol. Da sidebar on da right shows da food it costs.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.wood
text: Gather 50 wood: select a villager and right click on a tree lol. Da sidebar on da right shows ur wood.
